{{Short description|Algebraic geometry}}
In [[algebraic geometry]], a '''Fano fibration''' or '''Fano fiber space''', named after [[Gino Fano]], is a morphism of [[algebraic variety|varieties]] whose general fiber is a [[Fano variety]] (in other words has [[ample line bundle|ample]] [[anticanonical bundle]]) of positive dimension. The ones arising from extremal contractions in the [[minimal model program]] are called '''Mori fibrations''' or '''Mori fiber spaces''' (for [[Shigefumi Mori]]). They appear  as standard forms for  varieties without a minimal model.
